title: HalfCraft
tagline: Play Half-Life 2 and both Episodes as a Minecraft player: build, dig and fight in City 17.
description: Play all of Half-Life 2, Episode One, Episode Two and Lost Coast as a Minecraft player. Build and dig on Half-Life's maps, fight the Combine with a diamond sword, light City 17 with torches and swim in its canals. Half-Life's weapons become Minecraft items in your hotbar, the gravity gun tears blocks out as physics cubes, and loading a Half-Life save rolls your Minecraft blocks and inventory back too. Both games run at the same time: Minecraft runs hidden and Half-Life 2 draws everything.

version.note: Any current Steam version. Episode One and Episode Two chapters need the episodes, which come with Half-Life 2 today.
A Microsoft account that owns Minecraft: Java Edition. HalfCraft sets up Minecraft 26.3 itself.

ready.message: Starting Minecraft and Half-Life 2. The first time, sign in to Minecraft in the window that opens; Minecraft then downloads for a few minutes.

requirements.notes: Both games run at the same time. About 1 GB of free disk for Minecraft and Java, which download on the first start. Windows 10 or 11, 64-bit.
